_comment: Invariant identity fields used to fill job application forms. Read by the application-filler agent. Anything null is unknown and must never be guessed or inferred: ask. See context/profile/README.md.

needs_candidate._comment: Still unknown. The agent must stop and ask rather than infer any of these. When resolved, fill the value and add a short _note saying when it was confirmed.

work_and_logistics._comment: Fill in once confirmed. Applies to ALL applications.

never_answer._comment: The agent leaves these blank for the candidate every time, without exception. They are voluntary legal self-identification or attestations.
fields: any EEO or voluntary self-identification section
any signature, initials, or 'I certify that the above is true' attestation
any checkbox accepting terms, privacy policy, or background-check consent
any 'I acknowledge these answers are my own' or authenticity attestation

documents._comment: Optional repo-root files to attach when a form requires them, e.g. "transcript": "transcript.pdf". Resume and cover letter always come from outputs/<company>-<role>/.
